definition: `Underminer Agent W`: a performance relation `Performs a p` (agent a asserts, opines or has it appear that p; which act is fixed per instance), a feature `Feature w` of witnesses, and a thesis that denies the feature of every witness (`denies`, the thesis asserts not-X with X: some witness has the feature). `Held`: some agent performs the thesis. `Position`: the thesis holds and is held. The record does not say which positions are global underminers; that is a recorded class judgment per rival (#515).
note: A logical interface for one-instance-per-underminer retorsion, not a reading of any source. An instance is sourced through its own vocabulary (for example Aristotle's opining and being moved); the definition of the act and the feature belongs to that instance.
